entries.topic: The PayPal alumni network: the 2007 Fortune photo, companies, political spread

claims.text: Fortune photographed 13 PayPal alumni at Tosca, San Francisco, in October 2007 (photo Robyn Twomey): back row Jawed Karim (YouTube co-founder), Jeremy Stoppelman (Yelp CEO), Andrew McCormack (Laiola Restaurant), Premal Shah (Kiva president); second row Luke Nosek and Kenny Howery (Founders Fund), David Sacks (Geni), Peter Thiel (Clarium, Founders Fund), Keith Rabois (Slide), Reid Hoffman (LinkedIn), Max Levchin (Slide CEO), Roelof Botha (Sequoia), Russel Simmons (Yelp CTO). Musk was in Chicago receiving an award; Hurley and Chen did not attend; eBay bought PayPal for $1.5bn in 2002
Fortune 2007: 'Today they call upon one another when they need money or advice'; 'when they need both, they go to Thiel, who seems to be at the center of it all'

Fortune 2024: Hoffman 'a supporter of Democrats and various progressive causes' has clashed with Thiel and Sacks over their support of Trump; the 2007 photo posed in tracksuits and gold chains, a nod to The Sopranos

Sacks: born 25 May 1972 Cape Town; joined Confinity 1999, later PayPal COO; Yammer sold to Microsoft July 2012 for $1.2bn; Craft Ventures co-founded late 2017; $50,000 to Romney 2012; nearly $70,000 to Clinton 2016; 2022 co-hosted fundraiser for Vance and Masters with Rabois and gave over $1M to Senate candidates; June 2024 hosted Trump fundraiser raising about $12M; spoke at RNC July 2024; named AI and crypto czar 5 December 2024; Special Advisor 20 Jan 2025 to 26 Mar 2026

Rabois: PayPal EVP business development, public affairs and policy Nov 2000–Nov 2002; Square COO 2010–13; Khosla Ventures 2013–19 and from January 2024; Founders Fund GP 2019–Jan 2024; Opendoor co-founder 2014; September 2024 hosted Vance at a Trump fundraiser; no government appointment listed
Levchin: co-founded Confinity 1998 with Thiel, CTO to 2002; Slide sold to Google Aug 2010 for $182M; Affirm 2012; contributor to FWD.us; appointed 2015 to the CFPB advisory board for three years
Hurley co-founded YouTube in 2005 with PayPal colleagues Steve Chen and Jawed Karim; sold to Google 9 October 2006 for $1.65bn
Howery: PayPal co-founder and CFO 1998–2002; Founders Fund co-founded 2005 with Thiel and Nosek; ambassador to Sweden confirmed 17 Sept 2019 (62–32), served to 20 Jan 2021
Hoffman: nearly $9M to the Wisconsin Democratic Party since 2020; at least $7M to Harris's campaign (per CNN)
Founders Fund invested $20M in SpaceX (Musk statement 4 August 2008); managing partner Luke Nosek joined SpaceX's board
eBay spun off PayPal as an independent Nasdaq company (PYPL) in July 2015; record date 8 July 2015; CEO Dan Schulman
CBS: Sacks gave $1M of his own money to a pro-Vance super PAC (FEC); Vance helped organise the June 2024 $12M Trump fundraiser with Sacks and Chamath Palihapitiya; Thiel declined a $10M request

entries.topic: PayPal alumni and Thiel-network figures in government 2025-26, status as of October 2026

claims.text: TechCrunch 26 March 2026: Sacks's non-consecutive 130-day stint as a special government employee has ended; he continues as co-chair of PCAST with Kratsios; PCAST makes recommendations and does not make policy; Sacks: co-chair can 'make recommendations on not just AI but an expanded range of technology topics'; TechCrunch reported in 2025 on ethics waivers allowing him to keep AI and crypto stakes; he remains a Craft Ventures partner
EO 14177 (23 Jan 2025) s.2(c): 'The APST and the Special Advisor for AI & Crypto shall serve as Co-Chairs of the PCAST'

NYT via TechCrunch 30 Nov 2025: Sacks's disclosures list 708 tech investments, 449 of them AI companies; two White House ethics waivers; filings do not disclose remaining value or sale dates; Sacks called it a 'nothing burger'; White House: Sacks 'an invaluable asset'
Senate confirmed Howery 51–47 en bloc as ambassador to Denmark on 7 October 2025
Trump, announcing Howery's nomination (22 Dec 2024), wrote 'ownership and control of Greenland is an absolute necessity'
Howery in Nuuk for the US–Greenland–Denmark Joint Committee, December 2025
Howery hosted the embassy's 2026 New Year reception (report 14 January 2026)
Kratsios: CFO at Clarium from 2010, later Thiel Capital principal and Thiel's chief of staff; US CTO 2019–21; nominated OSTP director 22 Dec 2024; confirmed 74–25 on 25 March 2025

O'Neill: Thiel Foundation CEO 2009–12, Clarium/Thiel Capital managing director 2008–12, Mithril 2012–19; deputy HHS secretary (confirmed 52–43, June 2025); acting CDC director 28 Aug 2025–13 Feb 2026; left HHS 13 Feb 2026; nominated NSF director 2 March 2026
AAAS 20 May 2026 asked HELP Committee to schedule a confirmation hearing for O'Neill; none held as of that date
Musk posted 28 May 2025 'As my scheduled time as a Special Government Employee comes to an end'; 130-day limit could be reached 30 May 2025

Thiel spokesperson (per Reuters): 'Peter isn't involved in any plans or discussions regarding Greenland'; Reuters (April 2025) cited three people on a Greenland 'freedom city' push, two saying Thiel and Andreessen supported the idea; unclear whether either lobbied
